title: Temporary Model Snapshot & Retrieval Rights — Contract Module (Draft)
body:
Purpose and scope:

This draft contract module (the "Module") defines the limited circumstances, technical controls, and commercial terms under which a Customer may request a temporary snapshot of model artifacts and associated retrieval rights from Redwood Inference. The Module is intended to be inserted as an exhibit or annex to a primary agreement (eg, DPA, Master Services Agreement) where a Customer requires additional forensic or regulatory evidence about a specific inference event or model state.

Key definitions (working):
- "Snapshot": a time-bound capture of model-related artifacts — may include model weights (if allowed by model license), container image digest, runtime configuration, inference pipeline DAG, and immutable metadata (no raw customer prompts unless expressly requested and redacted).
- "Retrieval Package": the set of artifacts and logs provided to Customer under this Module for the purpose described in the Request.
- "Requesting Party": Customer or Redwood acting on Customer direction where permitted by law.
- "Forensic Purpose": regulatory inquiry, litigation, security incident investigation, or compliance audit.

1) Eligibility and permitted uses
- Customer may request a Snapshot only for a limited Forensic Purpose. Routine access for general model debugging is out of scope and should be handled via the Console/Support channels.
- Redwood may decline or redact elements of a Snapshot if providing them would: (a) violate third-party model license terms, (b) expose other customers' confidential data, or (c) trigger export-control obligations.

2) Request process and timelines (operational notes)
- Initial request submitted via secure form (link placeholder) with: incident ID / audit basis, date/time window, scope of artifacts requested, legal authorisation (if applicable).
- Redwood acknowledges within 48 hours and provides feasibility estimate (technical feasibility + license review).
- Typical window: 5–20 business days from acknowledgement to delivery depending on artifact complexity and RPM (redaction / legal) needs.
- Emergency expedited process: 24–72 hours acknowledgement; additional fees may apply.

3) Content of snapshot and redaction policy
- Standard Retrieval Package will include: model version/id, artifact digests (container & model), serving configuration (batching, KV cache policy), inference logs (redacted), agent/plugin manifests active at time-of-capture, and a manifest describing any redactions.
- Customer may request contemporaneous prompt/response pairs limited to the Case only; such content will be reviewed and redacted to remove other customers' data and internal operator notes. If log reconstruction requires re-playing queries into a sandboxed environment, Redwood will disclose methodology and the sandbox results rather than raw logs where appropriate.
- Redaction reasons will be documented in the manifest with statute/license references (eg: model license section X.X).

4) Security, transfer, and access controls
- Retrieval Packages are encrypted (customer-managed keys preferred). Transfer via authenticated SFTP or secure console download with ephemeral access link. Audit log entries for every access attempt will be included.
- Minimum personnel access: legal, named SRE on call, and a model-ops engineer. All access is recorded and reviewed.
- If customer requires in-person/on-premise review, Redwood and Customer will agree on scope and evidence-handling procedures in advance.

5) Export control, licensing and 3rd-party model constraints
- Where a Snapshot would disclose underlying model weights subject to third-party license or export controls, Redwood will: (a) notify Customer of the restriction within the feasibility estimate, (b) propose an alternative (eg, certified attestation, signed hash, or deterministic provenance report), and (c) only proceed with explicit written Customer consent and any additional contractual safeguards.
- For open-source models with weak provenance, Redwood will include provenance traces and seed/quantization profiles rather than raw weights unless the license explicitly permits weight transfer.

6) Fees, cost allocation, and retention
- Standard snapshot request: fixed flat fee (TBD) + pass-through for long-term storage if Customer elects retention > 90 days.
- Expedited or case-complex requests incur additional hourly engineering review fees.
- Redwood may retain an internal copy of the Retrieval Package for a limited quality-assurance window (30 days) solely to respond to follow-on legal/regulatory requests; retention beyond that requires Customer consent.

7) Confidentiality and permitted disclosures
- Retrieval Package treated as Confidential Information of Customer to the extent it contains Customer data. Redwood will not use the Retrieval Package for model training or benchmarking without prior written consent.
- Redwood may disclose to its counsel, insurers, or auditors under customary confidentiality obligations and notices to Customer.

8) Liability and indemnities (high level)
- Redwood warrants that it will take commercially reasonable measures to produce accurate manifests and to document redactions. No representation is made as to completeness of third-party model provenance beyond Redwood's records.
- Limitations on liability to follow primary agreement; propose carve-out for willful misconduct.

9) Dispute resolution and chain-of-custody verification
- Parties will agree on chain-of-custody hashing and notarisation approach for Retrieval Packages (e.g., signed manifest + TL;DR hash bundle) to minimize future disputes about tampering.
- If parties cannot agree on completeness of Snapshot, an independent technical auditor may be appointed (cost split TBD).

Open questions / implementation notes (internal):
- How to handle situations where runtime ephemeral KV caches contain transient customer secrets? Propose redaction + offer secure re-play in controlled sandbox only.
- Interaction with Redwood's telemetry minimisation policy: ensure redaction manifest includes telemetry sampling justification.
- Cross-border requests: need playbook re: data transfer restrictions and potential need for localised evidence review.
- Operational ticket template: include required legal attestation fields to speed license checks.

Appendix A: Example clause language (to be edited by legal):

"Customer Snapshot Right. Subject to the restrictions set forth in this Module, Customer may request, on a per-incident basis, a temporary retrieval package consisting of the artifacts and logs described in the Retrieval Package manifest. Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to produce the Retrieval Package consistent with the timelines in Section 2. Redwood may redact or withhold elements of any Retrieval Package where provision would violate applicable law, contractual obligations to third parties, or a model's licensing terms; in such case Redwood will provide a redaction manifest and the reasons for non-disclosure.

Customer acknowledges that certain third-party model weights and internal provider-only artifacts may be subject to export-control or license limitations and therefore may not be transferable. In lieu of transferring such artifacts, Redwood may provide (at Redwood's discretion) signed attestations, hashes, or deterministic provenance reports sufficient to support Customer's regulatory or forensic purpose.

Fees for Retrieval Packages will be charged as set forth in the applicable Order Form or fee schedule. Customer's election to retain a Retrieval Package beyond ninety (90) days is subject to additional storage fees and Redwood's retention policies.

Chain of custody: Redwood will provide a manifest and a signed hash bundle evidencing the Retrieval Package at the time of delivery. Any disputes regarding tampering or completeness shall be addressed in accordance with the Dispute Resolution provisions of the Agreement, and the Parties may mutually agree to appoint an independent technical auditor to adjudicate such disputes."

Notes to self: ensure export-control counsel signoff. Add real fee schedule examples and a template SFTP instruction sheet. Link to console feature request: CON-842 (artifact download UX).
